description: Subscribes an https webhook to a subject's events: ref, an agentId (a claimed Vlad account), a pay account, or a wallet that holds one. Mercatura POSTs { "type": "mercatura.webhook.verify", "nonce" } and the endpoint must answer 2xx with JSON { "verify": <hex HMAC-SHA256 of the nonce, keyed with the secret> }. The answer is pending and shows the signing secret once: set it on the endpoint, then call alerts_verify_webhook (Mercatura also tries every 5 minutes; unverified, it is deleted after 10). Each alert is a JSON POST with X-Mercatura-Timestamp and X-Mercatura-Signature: sha256=<hex HMAC-SHA256 of the timestamp, a dot, and the raw body, keyed with the secret>; 3 tries with backoff; turned off after 20 straight failures; at most one alert per rule per 10 minutes (more go together). The answer's unsubscribe.token stops it (alerts_unsubscribe). URL: https, standard port, a host name (no IP address). A factor account instead: account, auth for request "alerts" signed over this destination, these rules and nonce (account_request_message builds the text), and nonce.

account.description: Instead of ref: a factor account, for its owner (with auth and nonce).

auth.description: With account: the owner's signed request for request "alerts".

issued.description: The ISO 8601 UTC time in the signed text.

nonce.description: With account: the nonce in the signed text; it works once.

ref.description: An agentId (a whole number), a wallet, or a pay account (a 0x address).

rules.description: What to be told about. Public subjects: payments (every payment from a pay account), dailySpend (with dailySpendUsd: a pay account's UTC-day spending passes it), spenderLimit (a spender key at 80% of its daily limit), balanceUnder (with balanceUnderUsd: a pay account's USDG falls under it), vladOut (money out of a Vlad account), standingRuns, trades (Lapo traded the account's fund), security (spender keys, owners, top-up target). A factor account (with account and auth): factorMoves, factorPayments, factorFees, factorWithdrawals, factorChanges.

url.description: The https URL to POST alerts to.

name: alerts_subscribe_webhook
title: Alerts: send events to a webhook
